s1.quote: Esmerelda The Shark and Ray Alley for divers, this has been a feeding site for over 30 years … so divers can see the nurse sharks in all their glory

s2.quote: Esmeralda Canyons … a dive site for more experienced divers, as it involves navigating through deep canyons and swim-throughs in the reef … large groupers, snappers, barracudas, moray eels, nurse sharks

highlights.text: Nurse sharks at a long-running feeding site
Groupers, snappers, barracuda and moray eels in deep canyons

hazards.text: Deep canyons and swim-throughs suit experienced divers

summary.text: Canyon dive off Ambergris Caye near the Shark Ray Alley area, with deep cuts and swim-throughs best for experienced divers. Nurse sharks, groupers, snappers and morays are the main sights.

s1.quote: Tackle Box … The maximum depth on this dive can reach 100 feet … Caribbean Reef Sharks are common, as well as Nurse Sharks, Spotted Eagle Rays

s2.quote: Tackle Box Canyons … a spectacular intermediate site of steep grooves, deep narrow canyons with vertical walls, caverns and tunnels

highlights.text: Caribbean reef sharks, nurse sharks and eagle rays

summary.text: Canyon-and-groove reef about a mile off San Pedro with vertical walls, caverns and tunnels, dropping to around 30 m. Reef and nurse sharks and eagle rays are regularly seen; rated intermediate.

s1.quote: Tres Cocos … Tres Cocos is a spur-and-groove reef with deep and locally narrow canyons running perpendicular to the reef line … This is the spot where the sea turtles can be seen during the mating season

highlights.text: Deep, narrow canyons cutting across the reef

s1.quote: Mexico Rocks is a shallow patch reef complex located off the far northern tip of Ambergris Caye … about 2.5 to 5 metres (8 to 16 ft) deep … 17.9892°N 87.9058°W

s2.quote: Mexico Rocks … The water is on average 10-12 feet deep with excellent visibility inside the reef … over 100 clusters of massive boulder corals

s3.quote: Mexico Rocks, located right in front of Portofino Beach Resort Belize, is basically a cluster of coral heads … The shallow conditions and favorable light are perfect for underwater photography

highlights.text: Boulder coral heads in shallow water

summary.text: Shallow patch-reef complex off the northern tip of Ambergris Caye, a marine protected area of about 100 boulder-coral clusters in only a few metres of water. Good visibility and light make it popular for photography and snorkeling.

s1.quote: Turneffe Atoll is located southeast of Ambergris Caye and Caye Caulker … It is approximately 30 miles (48 kilometres) long and 10 miles (16 kilometres) wide, making it the largest coral atoll in Belize

notDiveSite.reason: Whole atoll about 48 km long, not a single dive site

s1.quote: St. George's Caye … is an island in the Caribbean Sea, eight miles east of Belize City

notDiveSite.reason: An island, not a single dive site

s1.quote: San Pedro is a town on the southern part of the island of Ambergris Caye in the Belize District of the nation of Belize

notDiveSite.reason: A town on Ambergris Caye, not a dive site

s1.quote: Half Moon Caye Wall Enjoy a drift dive along this spectacular wall to find Caribbean reef sharks, nurse sharks and a variety of rays

s2.quote: Half Moon Caye … The most colorful wall dive in the world … hidden tunnels of neon sponges

highlights.text: Caribbean reef sharks, nurse sharks and rays
Tunnels of neon sponges and canyons

summary.text: Drift dive along the celebrated wall of Half Moon Caye on Lighthouse Reef, known for vivid sponges, canyons and tunnels plus reef sharks, nurse sharks and rays.

s1.quote: The Aquarium at Long Caye … Highlight species include sea feathers and lace coral

s2.quote: the Aquarium lies on Long Caye just in front of Lighthouse Reef. Known for its table-top formation and steep 90-degree wall drop, this is an easy shallow drift dive with high visibility

summary.text: Wall at Long Caye on Lighthouse Reef with a table-top top and steep drop. An easy drift dive with high visibility, usually the third stop of a Blue Hole day trip.

sites.name: Great Blue Hole

s1.quote: The Great Blue Hole … as you descend to 130 feet in this sunken cave … stalagmites and stalactites up to 30 feet in length

s2.quote: this deep dive requires experience and a PADI advanced divers’ certification

s3.quote: Great Blue Hole is a large marine sinkhole off the coast of Belize … 124 m (407 ft) deep

highlights.text: Large stalactites and stalagmites in the sinkhole

summary.text: Circular marine sinkhole on Lighthouse Reef, 124 m deep. Advanced divers descend to about 40 m (130 ft) to see big stalactites, with very limited bottom time.

sites.depthNote: Sinkhole is 124 m deep; recreational dives go to about 40 m (130 ft)

s1.quote: Mermaids Lair Mermaid’s Lair is named after a large cavern … the depth ranges from 6 to 18 meters … The visibility is usually good, around 18 to 24 meters … green moray eels, lionfish, nurse sharks

highlights.text: Green moray eels, lionfish and nurse sharks

s1.quote: Mayan Princess Dive Site … a coral reef that drops off into a wall, where divers can see large sponges, sea fans, gorgonians … We had a nurse shark follow us the entire time on this dive

highlights.text: Large sponges, sea fans and gorgonians on the wall
